name: Andy Burnham
description: Follow Andy Burnham, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: The U.S. carries out a wave of strikes against Iran, as fighting between the two escalates, Congress faces long to-do list as August recess approaches, Andy Burnham becomes U.K.'s 7th prime minister.

changes.title: How Andy Burnham Becomes Britain’s New Prime Minister
changes.summary: Andy Burnham is set to become the next prime minister on Monday. Here’s how everything is expected to play out.

changes.title: Andy Burnham formally appointed U.K. prime minster
changes.summary: Andy Burnham was formally appointed the newest British prime minster, the seventh to take up the position in the last decade. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez reports on how Burnham differs from outgoing prime minster Keir Starmer and his meeting with King Charles III.

changes.title: Andy Burnham says politicians 'need to be better' in first speech as UK's new prime minister
changes.summary: Burnham spoke for several minutes outside 10 Downing St., where he promised to end street sleeping by homeless people and deliver a "circuit breaker" for a system he says has taken wrong turns since the 1980s.

changes.title: Why Britain is getting a new prime minister without a general election
changes.summary: Veteran Labour Party politician Andy Burnham has become Britain's new prime minister He takes over from Keir Starmer, who announced his resignation last month.

changes.title: There’s Nothing Casual About Andy Burnham’s Casual Style
changes.summary: Though it is smart. The new British prime minister is ushering in a new era of Westminster dressing.

changes.title: North Sea Drilling Offers First Test for Burnham’s Relationship With Trump
changes.summary: Andy Burnham has not yet met President Trump, but the two men will be expected to speak shortly after Mr. Burnham becomes prime minister.

changes.title: Andy Burnham: The likely next U.K. prime minister
changes.summary: Britain gets a new prime minister Monday and it's likely to be Andy Burnham, a self-declared socialist. Leigh Kiniry reports.

changes.title: Burnham Set to Become Britain’s First Openly Roman Catholic Prime Minister
changes.summary: Andy Burnham has spoken of Catholicism as part of his cultural identity rather than as a fervent religious faith.

changes.title: Five of the Main Challenges Awaiting Andy Burnham When He Becomes Prime Minister
changes.summary: Andy Burnham, who is set to enter Downing Street on Monday, faces a long and daunting list of issues. Here are some of the most urgent.
